records.source: Fish Focus: Super Cucumber. You can find this rare fish in the ocean. It only comes out in the evening, during summer and fall.
records.translation: Tampok na Isda: Super Pipino ng Dagat. Matatagpuan mo ang pambihirang isdang ito sa karagatan. Lumalabas lamang ito sa gabi tuwing tag-init at taglagas.

records.source: I know it's hard... but stop worrying so much about your horse! You can leave them anywhere and they'll make their way back home. They're very smart and independent animals!
records.translation: Alam kong mahirap... pero huwag mong labis na alalahanin ang kabayo mo! Maaari mo itong iwan saanman at kusa itong makababalik sa bahay. Napakatalino at kayang magsarili ng mga kabayo!

records.source: Here's an idea... start a wild tree orchard! Put tappers on those trees and harvest the valuable syrup. Or don't! See if I care.
records.translation: Narito ang isang ideya... magsimula ng taniman ng mga ligaw na puno! Maglagay ng mga Panistis sa mga punong iyon at anihin ang mahalagang arnibal. O huwag! Wala akong pakialam.

records.source: Item Spotlight: Keg. The classic use of a keg is to make wine out of grapes. But did you know you can make wine out of any fruit? Yep.^You can also make juice out of veggies.
records.translation: Tampok na Bagay: Bariles. Ang karaniwang gamit ng Bariles ay gawing alak ang mga ubas. Pero alam mo bang makagagawa ka ng alak mula sa anumang prutas? Oo.^Makagagawa ka rin ng katas mula sa mga gulay.

records.source: Do you have a journal? Don't forget to check it from time to time. It's easy to forget that you've written something important down.
records.translation: May Talaan ka ba? Huwag kalimutang tingnan iyon paminsan-minsan. Madaling malimutang may isinulat kang mahalagang bagay.

records.source: If you managed to get your hands on a 'rare seed', now's the time to plant it. Although it's said to take all season to grow, reliable sources have told me it actually takes just 24 days. The end result is rumored to be the sweetest fruit in the entire world.
records.translation: Kung nakakuha ka ng “pambihirang binhi”, ngayon na ang panahon upang itanim iyon. Bagaman sinasabing buong panahon bago ito lumaki, sinabi sa akin ng mga mapagkakatiwalaang pinagmulan na 24 na araw lang talaga iyon. Sinasabing ang bunga nito ang pinakamatamis na prutas sa buong mundo.

records.source: Some farmers have reported strange things happening when large fields of cauliflower, melon, or pumpkin reach maturity. Hmmm. I can't verify it, myself.
records.translation: May ilang magsasakang nag-ulat ng mga kakaibang pangyayari kapag ganap nang lumaki ang malalaking taniman ng Koliplor, melon, o kalabasa. Hmmm. Hindi ko iyon mapatunayan mismo.

records.source: It's blackberry season! Bushes across the countryside are overflowing with ripe fruit. Just go outside and see for yourself!
records.translation: Panahon na ng blackberry! Umaapaw sa hinog na prutas ang mga palumpong sa buong lalawigan. Lumabas ka at tingnan mo mismo!

records.source: Looking to get married? You're going to need a Mermaid's Pendant. Everyone this side of the Gem Sea knows what it means when you give them a Mermaid's Pendant.^Getting your hands on such a pendant can be tricky. Every region seems to have their own custom, but it always has something to do with the beach or ocean.
records.translation: Gusto mong magpakasal? Kakailanganin mo ng Palawit ng Sirena. Alam ng lahat sa bahaging ito ng Dagat ng Gem ang ibig sabihin kapag binigyan mo sila ng Palawit ng Sirena.^Maaaring mahirap makakuha ng gayong palawit. Tila may sariling kaugalian ang bawat rehiyon, pero lagi itong may kinalaman sa dalampasigan o karagatan.

records.source: Item Spotlight: Recycling Machine. Have you been catching a lot of junk while fishing? It's all too common in this day and age. Well, with a recycling machine you can turn those items into something useful. Just place your trash items into the machine and let it do its thing. Each type of trash produces different kinds of items.
records.translation: Tampok na Bagay: Makinang Pang-recycle. Marami ka bang nahuhuling basura habang nangingisda? Napakadalas niyon sa panahong ito. Gamit ang Makinang Pang-recycle, magagawa mong kapaki-pakinabang ang mga bagay na iyon. Ilagay lang ang mga basura sa makina at hayaang magproseso ang mga iyon. Bawat uri ng basura ay nagbibigay ng magkakaibang uri ng bagay.

records.source: Fish Focus: Albacore. This fish can be found either early in the morning or at night. Look for it in the ocean in fall or winter.
records.translation: Tampok na Isda: Albakora. Matatagpuan ang isdang ito sa madaling-araw o sa gabi. Hanapin ito sa karagatan tuwing taglagas o taglamig.

records.source: Fish Focus: Woodskip, sandfish, and scorpion carp. The woodskip is said to only live deep in the woods. The sandfish and scorpion carp can only be found in desert oases.
records.translation: Tampok na Isda: Woodskip, Isdang-Buhangin, at Karpang Alakdan. Sinasabing sa kailaliman lamang ng gubat naninirahan ang Woodskip. Sa mga oasis ng disyerto lamang matatagpuan ang Isdang-Buhangin at Karpang Alakdan.

records.source: It's just a couple days until communities around the Ferngill Republic celebrate Spirit's Eve! One tradition you may not know of is the search for the golden pumpkin. If your town has a haunted maze, then you can be sure there's a golden pumpkin hidden somewhere. Those things are valuable!
records.translation: Ilang araw na lang bago ipagdiwang ng mga komunidad sa buong Republika ng Ferngill ang Bisperas ng mga Espiritu! Isang kaugaliang maaaring hindi mo alam ang paghahanap ng Ginintuang Kalabasa. Kung may labirintong pinagmumultuhan sa bayan ninyo, tiyak na may Ginintuang Kalabasang nakatago roon. Mahalaga ang mga iyon!

records.source: Folks, take my advice. You're going to need a nursery in your house before you can have kids. Baby needs a crib!
records.translation: Mga kaibigan, sundin ang payo ko. Kakailanganin mo ng silid-pambata sa bahay bago ka magkaroon ng mga anak. Kailangan ng sanggol ng kuna!

records.source: Item Spotlight: Crystalarium. This amazing machine can create infinite copies of any kind of gemstone. Just place the gemstone you'd like to copy in the machine let it do its thing. It might take a while, but hey... that's pure profit!
records.translation: Tampok na Bagay: Kristalaryum. Makagagawa ang kahanga-hangang makinang ito ng walang-hanggang kopya ng anumang uri ng hiyas. Ilagay lang sa makina ang hiyas na gusto mong kopyahin at hayaang magproseso ito. Maaaring matagalan, pero hoy... purong kita iyon!

records.source: If you have adult barn animals, and space left in your barn... there's always a chance one of your animals could give birth. It's something to keep in mind.
records.translation: Kung may ganap nang lumaking mga hayop ka sa Kamalig at may natitirang puwang doon... laging may pagkakataong manganak ang isa sa mga hayop mo. Mabuting tandaan iyon.

records.source: Fish Focus: Catfish. This relatively rare fish comes out of hiding when it rains. You'll find them living in rivers beside towns, where they enjoy feeding on whatever scraps end up in the water. They don't like hot weather, so don't bother fishing for them in the summer!
records.translation: Tampok na Isda: Hito. Lumalabas mula sa pinagtataguan ang medyo pambihirang isdang ito kapag umuulan. Matatagpuan mo silang naninirahan sa mga ilog sa tabi ng mga bayan, kung saan nasisiyahan silang kainin ang anumang tirang pagkain na napupunta sa tubig. Ayaw nila ng mainit na panahon, kaya huwag mo silang subukang hulihin sa tag-init!

records.source: Item Spotlight: Worm Bin. Need an endless supply of bait? Build yourself a worm bin. Once you've got one going, you'll get a few pieces of bait every single day.
records.translation: Tampok na Bagay: Kahon ng Uod. Kailangan mo ba ng walang-hanggang panustos ng pain? Gumawa ka ng Kahon ng Uod. Kapag gumagana na iyon, makakakuha ka ng ilang piraso ng pain araw-araw.

records.source: Underneath all that snow, spring seeds are champing at the bit to start their new lives in the sun. Don't be surprised when spring rolls around and your farm needs some tidying up!
records.translation: Sa ilalim ng lahat ng niyebeng iyon, sabik na sabik ang mga binhi ng tagsibol na simulan ang kanilang bagong buhay sa araw. Huwag magulat kapag dumating ang tagsibol at kailangan ng kaunting paglilinis ang bukid mo!

records.source: If you've got your hands on a gold pan, keep an eye out for something sparkly in the water.^There's often good ore in there, free for the taking!
records.translation: Kung nakakuha ka ng Kawaling Ginto, magmasid sa anumang kumikislap sa tubig.^Madalas ay may magandang mineral doon na libre mong makukuha!

records.source: Folks, I've got an announcement to make. This is the last new episode of Livin' Off The Land before my retirement. I've had a good time, and I'll miss you folks. Oh, and I've been told the station's going to start playing reruns next year. ^^Take care!
records.translation: Mga kaibigan, may pahayag ako. Ito ang huling bagong episode ng Pamumuhay Mula sa Lupa bago ako magretiro. Nagsaya ako at mangungulila ako sa inyo. Oh, at sinabi sa akin na magsisimulang magpalabas ang estasyon ng mga pag-uulit sa susunod na taon. ^^Mag-ingat kayo!
